div.head: VI As 1.5
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe þeof wrecan wille ⁊ ǽhlip gewyrce oððe on stræte togeliht, beo CXX scll' scildig wið þone cing. Gif he þonne mann ofslea on þa wrace, beo hé his feores scyldig ⁊ ealles þæs þe he áge, buton se cing him arian wille.

Et qui furem uindicare uelit et euocacionem faciet uel ad eum liberandum in uia descendet, CXX sol. reus sit apud (erga) regem. Si hominem occidat in ea ƿrace (uindicta), de uita forisfactus sit et de omnibus que habebit, nisi rex ei uelit misereri.

⁊ se þe þeof wrecan wille ⁊ ǽhlip gewyrce oððe on stræte togeliht, beo CXX scll. scildig wið þone cing. Gif he þonne mann ofslea on þa wrace, beo hé his feores scyldig ⁊ ealles þaes þe he áge, buton se cing him arian wille.

Und wer einen Dieb rächen will und einen Angriff verübt oder [ihm beim Transport] auf der Strasse beispringt, sei gegenüber dem König 120 Schill. schuldig. Wenn er aber einen Menschen erschlägt bei dieser Rächung [des Diebes], habe er sein Leben verwirkt und alles was er besitzt, ausser wenn der König ihn begnadigen will.

And whoever wishes to avenge a thief and commits an assault or rescues [him while he is being taken] on the road, let him be liable to the king for 120 shillings. But if he kills someone in this avenging [of the thief], let him have forfeited his life and all that he owns, unless the king is willing to pardon him.

And he who wishes to avenge a thief and has recourse to violence, or comes to his aid on the high road, shall forfeit 120 shillings to the king. If, however, he slays anyone in the act of vengeance, he shall forfeit his life and all he possesses, unless the king is willing to pardon him.

Hier wird II 6, 3, wo die Nicht-Verwundung der Strafvollstrecker vorlag, ergänzt. Vgl. Gl Rechtssperrung 3b; Angriff 4
Here II 6, 3, where the case of the executors of the penalty not being wounded was dealt with, is supplemented. Cf. Gl Rechtssperrung 3b; Angriff 4
Quadr. translates uel ad eum liberandum in uia descendet. On stræte is probably to be understood as the road along which the thief is being taken under arrest.
